system.description:
"Forged by ancient dwarven smiths from solid silver and inscribed with runes of earth and stone, this heavy pick shatters rock and dark magic with equal ease."

Heavy Silver Mining Pick — d8 damage, Silvered. Tailored for Prince Vega. 2 Gift Dice (house count, matching the Staff — tune as desired).

Silvered: bypasses the natural armor/immunity of werewolves, ghouls, wights, and spectral undead. Shatterstone: ignores 1 Armor on stone, metal, crystal, or lycanthrope targets.

Seismic Resonance ([DICE]/[SUM]): strike the ground — [DICE] Nearby creatures make a RESOLVE test or fall prone and are stunned 1 round; deal [SUM] Earth damage to stone structures, geodes, or constructs.

Shatter Vein ([DICE]/[SUM]): vs stone, crystal, or heavy armor — modify the attack up to [SUM]; on a hit deal [SUM] extra and reduce the target's Armor by [DICE] for the combat.

Recharge: embed the head in unmined silver ore or solid stone for a minute during a Picnic or Rest, or strike an uncorrupted stone altar.
